scope: Local implementation/restart validation and fixed-checkpoint inference; no training, publication or model upload.
model: S3/a11_b02; original single-layer CKDA d_model48 heads12 head_dim16; same 3 trained checkpoints

fresh.empirical_horizon: all observed group-token positions; not a confidence lower bound
fresh.supported_horizon: largest declared grid position with one-sided exact binomial upper bound <= epsilon, Bonferroni alpha/195
fresh.tau: first wrong or INVALID group-token prediction; no recovery in survival
fresh.bootstrap_scope: pointwise input-paired within checkpoint, no seed pooling

candidate_selection.rank_basis: unchanged v1 CAL basis, no refit
candidate_selection.mixed: start5bits; descending v1 mixed_scores over192head/keychannels, stable flattened-index tie; promote6bits until next actual N128 serialized total exceeds R2 cap
candidate_selection.prior_outcome_influence: This narrow follow-up candidate list uses already explored v1 observations. The comparator uses only frozen CAL scores and measured serialization lengths.

runtime.numeric_state_failure: terminal; preserve previous committed body and RNG; consume cursor
runtime.terminal_noop: consume cursor only; no transition/RNG; invalid output
runtime.bad_program_input_checkpoint_oom_crash: execution error, never algorithmic terminal event
runtime.header: cursor<u8, terminal_codeu1, first_terminal_write<u8; active sentinel UINT64_MAX

historical.selected_numeric_failures: Four original arm/seed cells; smallest recorded first_invalid_write_position, ties smallest original stream index; exact input replay at B1; report any mismatch vs original B512
historical.v1_reviewer_probe: Requested independent review archive absent at design freeze; separately recreated synthetic contract probe from prompt, not claimed reviewer script execution

precision.coefficients: Promote retained FP32 q/k/v/alpha/beta/g/e representation; never recompute projections/gates in double
precision.D01: FP32 recurrence/promote state/fixed weight explicit FP64 readout
precision.D11: FP64 recurrence/fixed weight explicit FP64 readout
precision.statistical_role: diagnostic only; no simultaneous family or codec selection

trace.reference: independent evaluator native FP32 and FP64 shadows; never passed to candidate
trace.validity: Terminal scratch zeros excluded; scalar-only NPZ, finite masks/nulls; before/after first error

timing.scope: complete transition/projection/packing/status/original readout, denominator16*128 group tokens; load/io/gold/shadow outside timer
timing.arm_order: ARMS fixed order repeated3; descriptive prototype cost, no speedup claim

resume: same logical input order/batch shape; persist verified runtime plus cumulative evaluator history atomically; no overwrite completed results
attempts: technical repair may resume same incomplete settings with new attempt record; no outcome-driven rerun
